copy.tagline: 把网页应用发布到 Vercel，管理域名和环境变量

copy.tagline_en: Deploy web apps to Vercel and manage domains and env vars
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly deploy websites to Vercel and manage their settings.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会用 vercel CLI 把 Web 应用部署到 Vercel,并管理项目、域名和环境变量;部署前先跑本地构建,部署成功后确认状态和在线链接可访问,再把链接发给你。
howto.when: 当你要求部署、发布或上线一个 Web 应用,或需要管理 Vercel 项目、域名、环境变量时触发。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude deploys your web app to Vercel with the vercel CLI and manages projects, domains, and env vars. It runs a local build, then confirms deployment status and the live URL before sharing the link.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to deploy, ship, or publish a web application, or to manage Vercel projects, domains, and environment variables.

say_en.text: Deploy this project to Vercel production
say_en.note: Runs a local build, deploys, then checks the link
Returns the deployment records from the CLI
